done_when: A review run keeps every readable finding; a finding with no score line is judged by its priority and close names each such finding; a finding with no code_location or an unknown priority still makes the run unreadable, and that message names the saved raw output's path
why: Issue #979: Forge drops every Autoreview finding when one finding has no Gain/Work/Harm score line, so a chunked review with two unscored P1 findings fails twice and close stops with no findings shown
